0022600009.text: The Spurs (0-1, losers of their last game) are 5th in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 15th in the West, and they play this one at home. Jayden Quaintance is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. Houston has not played a 2026-27 game yet, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8.
